task: Cycle 3: test whether A06 complete-law KL supports uniform fresh-prefix prediction

status_key.derived_proved: Two-world construction and bounds are proved directly in CYCLE3_REPORT.md; not externally reviewed.
status_key.scope_boundary: Counterexample applies to the stated uniform conditional target, not A06's actual-path objective.

interface.source: Independent complete trajectories from unknown P_b.
interface.teacher: One fixed exact rational Q evaluator/sampler, identical in both source worlds.
interface.deployment_target_tested: Uniform conditional terminal-bit TV error <=1/3 on every supplied prefix, including h*=0^n, with success >=2/3.
interface.relation_to_A06: A06 instead asks for actual-path bounded-task MSE O(zeta)+epsilon^2 and does not require a uniform conditional guarantee.

claims.claim: For rho=2^-n, P_b has uniform fair X_1..X_n and terminal Y=b deterministically only when X=0^n, otherwise Y is fair. The shared teacher Q is uniform on all n+1 bits. Both worlds have KL(P_b||Q)=rho ln 2, TV(P_b,Q)=rho/2, and TV(P_0,P_1)=rho. Both sources have O(n) clock/flag states with probabilities in {0,1/2,1}; Q is positive and exactly evaluable.
claims.uniform_target_lower_bound: TV(P_0^m,P_1^m)=1-(1-rho)^m<=m rho. For m<=2^(n-2), equal-prior testing success is at most 5/8. A conditional predictor within 1/3 TV at h*=0^n would test b with success >=2/3, contradiction. Thus Omega(2^n)=Omega(1/zeta_n) complete P trajectories are necessary even with unlimited exact Q queries.

costs.passive_data: Each P trajectory has n+1 symbols; the lower bound is Omega(n 2^n) observed symbols.
costs.teacher: Any number of calls is uninformative because every Q answer is identical in the two worlds; a conditional Q call is O(1), full word probability output is O(n) bits.
costs.conditional_control: One chosen-prefix conditional sample from P at h*=0^n returns b deterministically; prefix specification costs n bits.

claims.claim: At cut t<=n, only prefix 0^t has nonzero conditional TV from Q; its P mass is 2^-t and conditional TV is 2^-(n-t+1). Therefore E_P[TV(P(.|H_t),Q(.|H_t))^2]=2^(-2n+t-2)<=2^-n/4=zeta_n/(4 ln 2). For every bounded future task the squared conditional-mean error is at most this value, simultaneously over tasks at that cut.
claims.consequence: The constant-state recurrence for Q itself satisfies this pair's actual-path O(zeta_n) loss whenever C>=1/(4 ln 2). The lower bound only refutes the stronger uniform-over-prefixes target; it does not refute the A06 canonical objective.

claims.claim: A chosen-prefix source-conditional oracle can resolve the two worlds with one query at h*=0^n, while Q conditional access and Q simulation cannot distinguish them.
claims.scope: This access separation demonstrates why source-conditional sample results do not automatically transfer to passive P samples plus an approximate teacher.

claims.claim: The older workspace rare-prefix result was not reopened or relied on; this construction and proof were derived directly for the A06 P-samples-plus-Q interface.
